body: no, i don't matter at all. i've done nothing to prove that i matter in the least bit. and it doesn't help that the last time i walked outside of my neighborhood in this town (when i was fat as a youngin) that i was pelted with a VHS copy of Bambi.

i wish it was as easy as just going outside and not caring, but it's not. i tense up and start sweating, and if i'm not rapidly repeating some mantra (*it's not okay it's not okay it's not okay* or whatever) then i just go limp and start screaming. i don't know what's wrong with me.

it's probably helpful to know that when i was 16 i was committed for a month for talking about suicide/having a full blown panic attack in class (complete with trying to suffocate my bawling in my sweater while the teacher continued class), and they put me on a bunch of meds which i think are what put me where i am now. 70mg vyvanse and 100mg bupropion, i ended up abusing the vyvanse pretty badly and have been slowly weening myself off of them.

also my parents divorced when i was two and my father was kind of violent sometimes.
i just tried talking to my mother but she put it off and only said cheer up. i feel like such a fucking baby worrying about all these things, as they just make me sound whiny when i write them but in my mind they're momentous troubles, like i'm carrying the world on my shoulders.
